# Steam Community

> Steam Community is Valve's integrated social and marketplace platform where gamers discover games, trade items, create and share mods, discuss gameplay, and connect with other players.

Steam Community serves as the central hub for millions of players to engage with games through discussions, user-generated content, item trading, and community-driven features. It connects players across thousands of game titles while providing tools for content creators and traders.

## Key Topics

- Steam Community
- Steam Workshop
- Steam Community Market
- Game Hubs

## Core Community Features

- [Steam Community](https://steamcommunity.com): Steam Community homepage with game hubs, marketplace, and social features
- [Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions): Steam Community discussion platform with forums and community moderation
- [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop): Steam Workshop for user-generated content and mod creation
- [Steam Community Market](https://steamcommunity.com/market): Steam Community Market for buying, selling, and trading items

## Game Community Hubs

- [Warframe](https://steamcommunity.com/app/230410): Warframe game community hub with discussions and guides
- [Call of Cthulhu](https://steamcommunity.com/app/399810): Call of Cthulhu horror game community page with discussions
- [Need for Speed™ Heat](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1222680): Need for Speed Heat racing game community hub
- [Tomb Raider](https://steamcommunity.com/app/203160): Tomb Raider game community hub with guides and reviews

## User Account Features

- [Wishlist](https://steamcommunity.com/my/wishlist): Error page for Steam Wishlists user account feature

## Optional

- [Shared Files Error](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails): Error page for shared files or item not found
